correctness.rationale: The frozen-prefix decomposition is exact because e_t=X_t-(t+1) satisfies nonnegative e_{t+1}=e_t+u_t+e_{u_t}, so any history with final e_n=r cannot use index j>r after time r. The full later steps then draw from fixed indices 0..r with fixed increment weights j+e_j; expanding (1+B_prefix(z))^(n-r) gives nonnegative integer h_{r,k} coefficients and degree r. The leading h_rr=1 comes from all-zero prefixes, the next coefficient 2(r-1) from exactly one 2-increment or a single early 1-prefix. Comparing to independent inversion codes, feedback requires excess at least four, so all prefixes of excess <=2 agree, while the unique excess-one prefix starting at t=1 invalidates exactly r-2 uses of later index two. Hence the r-2 coefficient difference r-2 and n^2(1-A/M)->r(r-1)(r-2) for fixed r>=3.
